vcs.blame.description: who last changed each line of a file

vcs.branches.description: local and remote branches, most recent first

vcs.diff.description: a unified diff, a row per line; an untracked path shows as all added

ref.description: compare with this ref (default: the index); a..b for a range

vcs.log.description: commits, newest first, with the graph on request

ref.description: branch or ref (default HEAD; all for every branch)

vcs.status.description: changed files: path and state; query keeps those with the text in their path or content

query.description: keep the files whose path or content has this text

vcs.amend.description: fold the changes into the last commit (it rewrites that commit)

message.description: a new message; empty keeps it

vcs.branch-delete.description: delete a local branch, or a remote one named origin/x

force.description: also when it is not merged

vcs.checkout.description: switch to a branch, a remote branch or a release tag (detached)

vcs.cherry-pick.description: apply a commit onto the current branch

all.description: stage every tracked change first (the default when nothing is staged)

vcs.discard.description: throw away a path's changes, staged or not (confirmed: they are not recoverable)

vcs.export.description: check a ref out into a cached directory (built, run or tested without touching the working tree)

vcs.fetch.description: fetch every remote, with its tags, dropping branches deleted there

vcs.merge.description: merge a branch into the current one

vcs.pull.description: fast-forward the current branch from its upstream

vcs.push.description: push a branch (confirmed: it changes the shared remote)

vcs.rebase.description: replay the current branch on another (it rewrites the branch's commits)

vcs.revert.description: a new commit that undoes one

vcs.stage.description: stage a path for the next commit, or every change; unstage takes it back out

pop.description: apply and drop this stash (stash@{0}) instead of saving one

vcs.stash-apply.description: apply a stash and keep it

vcs.tag.description: tag a commit, and push the tag on request
